message: Build a professional analytics dashboard as a React app: sidebar navigation, header, KPI stat cards, charts, a data table with search and filtering, date-range controls, loading and empty states, error states, responsive layout for tablet and phone. Use clearly labeled sample data, no live data. Performance matters: fast initial rendering.
